result: The project page now shows the app's ready popover as a live HTML/CSS copy in front of the warning card, with its scan bar sweeping. It's one commit, `9b3dc01`, on `story/006`, and the tree is clean apart from `.review-out/`. **What changed in `site/index.html`** - **Order:** `.shots` holds the warning `` first, unchanged, and the popover last, so it paints in front. The page no longer refers to `ready.png`; the file stays in the repo. - **The popover:** one `div` with `role="img"` and the old alt text as its label. Its two parts are `aria-hidden`, and nothing inside can take focus. It has the title, the ⇧⌘2 chip, the viewfinder with corners, the `scanline` bar, the two-line prompt, Scan and the hint. - **Styling:** copied from `src/styles.css`, with every rule scoped under `.popover` so the page and the copy can't restyle each other. The app's `--paper` becomes the page's `--sheet`. The chip is in Sometype Mono; the title, prompt, Scan and hint are in Silkscreen. - **Layout:** the two sides are swapped. The warning image is held left at -3deg, and the popover right, 22% lower, at 4deg, with `overflow: hidden`. - **Motion:** the bar uses the app's `sweep` (2.8s ease-in-out, infinite), and nothing else animates. The reduced-motion block adds the app's `animation: none !important`. **Tests** - **New test:** `src/__tests__/siteReadyPopover.test.ts`, 16 tests for AC1–AC4. It reads the page's rules through jsdom's CSSOM. - On the original page 10 of them failed, with every AC failing somewhere. Now all 16 pass, and the full vitest suite passes (74 tests). - `tsc --noEmit` and eslint are clean on it. I didn't run the cargo commands. - The test is stricter than the story in a few places.
